title: Tax Clearance Certificate Extraction Schema
description: Schema for extracting all structured and visible data from a Nepali tax clearance certificate.

emblem_present.description: True if the Coat of Arms of Nepal is visible at the top left; always set true unless the image is cropped.

office_name.description: Full office name/heading (in Nepali or English, as present) at top center, starting with 'नेपाल सरकार' and including department/ministry/sub-office names. Keep line breaks as single spaces. Extract exactly as printed.

letter_no.description: The printed letter number (पत्र संख्या) in the information header near the upper left, exactly as shown.

registration_no.description: The registration or reference number (चलानी नं) in the upper header block. Extract exactly as printed.

tax_notice_no.description: Tax Notice Number (कर सूचना नं) in the header, upper left.

issue_date_nepali.description: The Nepali-issued date (in Bs) (यो पत्र मिति ... मा तयार गरिएको छ) at the top right. Extract exactly as printed.

print_date_nepali.description: The print date in Nepali (प्रिन्ट मिति ... ) at upper right. Extract exactly as printed.

qr_present.description: True if QR code box is present in the header right area. Always true unless document is cropped.

subject.description: The subject line (विषय:) below the info block. Should always be 'कर चुक्ता प्रमाण पत्र' for this type.

recipient_name.description: The recipient's full name (श्री ...) below the subject, in Devanagari. Extract exactly as shown.

recipient_address.description: Recipient's address block — the lines after the name, e.g., 'का.म.न.पा. १९, बागमती', plus any visible phone number. Collapse into a single line with commas if multi-line.

recipient_pan.description: Personal PAN number of the recipient, as printed below the address block.

main_text.description: Full body text of the certificate explaining the clearance, extracted exactly as printed, including dates and numbers. Do not edit or summarize.

income_items.description: Structured rows from the 'आयका शिर्षकहरू' table, one per row with column headers and amounts as printed.

item.description: Income item title, exactly as shown in the left column.

amount.description: Amount in NPR, as printed in the right column. Keep exact punctuation and formatting.

total_income.description: Total income as printed in the final row (अन्तिम समयमा कट्टी तथा कर सूचिमा भएको आय), right cell.

signature_label.description: Text immediately above or beside the officer signature (e.g. (कर अधिकृत), or handwritten text: usually (Signed)). If handwritten, transcribe it exactly as shown.

certifying_officer_name.description: Printed or handwritten name of certifying officer if present. Extract exactly as it appears below the signature line.

certifying_officer_title.description: Title of certifying officer or official designation next to signature: (कर अधिकृत) etc.

remarks.description: Footer notes (पुनश्च:), containing all visible legal/instructional notes at the bottom, below the signature area. Extract all visible lines, separated by double space or semicolons if multiline.
